contixo - f15 astro mini drone with 2.4\.description: Take flight in seconds with the Contixo F15 Astro Mini Drone with 2.4" Screen Remote Control, a compact and beginner-friendly drone designed for fun aerial exploration. Featuring a built-in 2.4" display on the controller, you can see what the drone sees in real time—no phone or app required. The HD camera system captures smooth 720P video at 30fps, letting you record and view your flights instantly. With one-click takeoff and landing, even first-time pilots can get airborne quickly. The optical flow hover technology helps the drone stay stable in the air, making it easier to control and capture clearer footage. A 60° field-of-view camera lens with -90° to 90° adjustable angle allows you to customize your perspective while flying. The Astro Mini Drone offers up to 350 ft control range and 150 ft video transmission range, delivering responsive control and a reliable connection. Weighing only 68g (2.4 oz), it’s lightweight, portable, and perfect for indoor or outdoor flying. With two rechargeable batteries included, you can extend your flight sessions and enjoy up to 6 minutes of flight time per battery. Add some excitement to every flight with 360° stunt rolls and intuitive controls. Available in Blue, Pink, and Green, the Astro Mini Drone makes a great gift for beginners, kids, and drone enthusiasts alike.
